premises.text: Combustion-based power systems are highly inefficient and emit millions of tons of CO2
premises.evidence_span: These combustion power plants fail. They are highly inefficient, they are not flexible, and they emit millions of tons of CO2.

premises.text: A new power generation solution can achieve 80% efficiency and has a carbon-negative footprint
premises.evidence_span: Our solution produces power at a groundbreaking efficiency of 80%. It is fully reversible... and it even has a carbon-negative footprint.

premises.text: The new power generation system eliminates combustion and achieves 100% fuel conversion
premises.evidence_span: In our varying units, we have eliminated the combustion completely... we achieve 100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency.

premises.text: The system can produce renewable power from biogas and separate pure CO2
premises.evidence_span: we produce renewable power from the biogas, while separating pure CO2.

premises.text: Doubling electric efficiency can significantly increase revenues for customers
premises.evidence_span: the doubling in electric efficiency first of all means doubling revenues from electricity.

premises.text: The system can provide significant power and CO2 separation for households and biogas plants
premises.evidence_span: One single of our revering containers can provide up to 500 households with renewable gas and power while separating almost 2 kilotons of CO2 from the atmosphere every year.

premises.text: The global market for replacing fossil-based power plants is valued at 7 trillion US dollars
premises.evidence_span: we can replace all fossil-based power plants, which is a 7 trillion US dollar market.

value.text: The world can benefit from decentralized, carbon-negative, and highly efficient power plants
value.evidence_span: join us to provide the world with decentralized, carbon-negative and highly efficient power plants.

notes: No separate premises for technology components as they are part of the overall system design.
